Yang Jing at "Love・Kill" Promotional Event

Yang Jing, known for her role in the upcoming erotic thriller "Love・Kill," poses in a fitted black dress with a unique neckline. Her hair is pulled back into a simple updo, and soft bangs frame her face, complementing her natural makeup
